body: Ye and Kim brought North flowers after she headlined her first solo show in Chicago The moment appears in North newest YouTube vlog , giving fans a look behind the scenes of the performance and the celebration afterward. After previously joining her dad onstage, this time North had a show of her own, with both parents showing their support. The flowers made for a personal moment after a big night for North as she continues developing her own music and stage presence.
